hadith:
Menstrual Periods - Narrated by Al-Qasim -  Volume 1, Book 6, Number 293 

'Aisha said, "We set out with the sole intention of performing Hajj and when we reached Sarif, (a place six miles from Mecca) I got my menses. Allah's Apostle came to me while I was weeping. He said 'What is the matter with you? Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'This is a thing which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do with the exception of the Taw-af (Circumambulation) round the Ka'ba." 'Aisha added, "Allah's Apostle sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Baari - الْبَارِئُ - The Maker of Order

The name Al Baari derives from the Arabic root 'ب ر أ' (B-R-ʾ), which conveys the concept of bringing into existence or creating. It emphasizes Allah's authority and power in shaping the universe and everything within it from non-existence to existence, tailoring each creation with purpose and precision.
verse:
Al-Mulk - The Sovereignty - 67:14

How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware.
